AC/DC - Live Wire | Live at Oakland Coliseum 1979 | Day On The Green
Recorded live on July 21, 1979, at the Oakland-Alameda County Coliseum, this performance captures the Australian rock powerhouse during their legendary tour supporting 'Highway to Hell'. In front of an audience of over 60,000 sun-drenched fans, AC/DC delivered a masterclass in stripped-down hard rock dynamics, driven by Bon Scott's swaggering stage presence and Angus Young's blistering Gibson SG assault.
The Live Lineup:
• Bon Scott* – Lead Vocals
• Angus Young* – Lead Guitar
• Malcolm Young* – Rhythm Guitar, Backing Vocals
